transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you here today?

I guess the main thing that pushed me to come in is my eating has been really off. Some days I just forget to eat meals completely, and then other nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout and snacks. It’s been kind of all over the place, and it scared me a bit.

Can you tell me more about the nights when you’re up eating a lot of takeout and snacks? Do you feel like you’re eating a larger amount of food than most people would in a short period of time, and do you try to compensate for it in any way, like vomiting or exercising?

Yeah, it feels like a lot sometimes. Like I’ll skip meals or just forget to eat during the day, and then late at night I’m suddenly tearing through takeout and snacks after midnight. That’s honestly what scared me enough to come in. I haven’t really been keeping track of how much compared to other people, but it feels out of control when it happens.
When you're eating a lot late at night, do you feel like you can't stop eating or control how much you're eating?

Yeah, in the moment it feels kind of hard to stop. It’s not every night, but when it happens, I’ll realize I’m just going through takeout and snacks after midnight, especially if I forgot to eat earlier, and it feels all over the place.
When you're eating a lot late at night, do you feel like you can't control how much you're eating or that you can't stop once you've started?

Yeah… I guess that’s the part that worries me. Some days I’ll barely eat or forget meals completely, and then other nights I’m up after midnight just tearing through takeout and snacks. It feels kind of out of control when it happens.
Has this eating pattern been causing you a lot of distress or affecting your daily life in any way?

Yeah, it has been stressing me out. Honestly, that’s kind of what pushed me to come in — my eating feels all over the place. Some days I forget meals completely, and then other nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout and snacks. It just doesn’t feel normal for me.
Do these episodes of eating a lot at night usually happen after you've skipped or forgotten meals during the day, or do they also happen even if you've eaten normally during the day?

Usually it’s after I’ve skipped meals or just forgot to eat much during the day. Then later at night it kind of catches up with me, and I’ll be up after midnight going through takeout or snacks. That’s the part that scared me into coming in—it feels all over the place.
When you're eating a lot at night, do you find yourself eating much more quickly than usual or feeling like you need to keep eating even after you're full?

Yeah, I mean… I don’t know if I’m eating faster exactly, but it feels like once I start, I’m just tearing through stuff. Like takeout, snacks, whatever’s there, usually after midnight. It’s more that my eating feels all over the place — some days I forget meals completely, and then it kind of hits me at night.
Do you usually eat alone during these late-night eating episodes because you're embarrassed about how much you're eating?

Yeah, usually I’m alone when it happens, but it’s more because it’s late and I’m just up. I do feel kind of embarrassed afterward, though. The main thing is my eating’s been all over the place — some days I forget meals, then other nights I’m tearing through takeout and snacks after midnight.
Do you ever feel like you can’t control how much you’re eating during the day, or does that mainly happen at night?

Mostly at night. During the day it’s more like I forget to eat or skip meals, and then later it catches up with me. After midnight is when I end up tearing through takeout or snacks, and that’s what made me worried.
Do these late-night eating episodes happen after you've already gone to bed and woken up, or are you still up and just eating later into the night?

I’m usually still up, just eating later into the night. It’s not like I went to bed and woke up to eat. Some days I forget meals completely, and then after midnight I’ll be tearing through takeout or snacks. That’s the part that kind of scared me.
How often do these late-night eating episodes happen? Would you say they occur at least once a week?

Yeah, I’d say at least once a week. It’s not every single night, but often enough that it freaked me out. Some days I barely eat or forget meals, and then other nights I’m up after midnight just going through takeout and snacks.
Do you ever feel like you can’t control how much you’re eating during the day, or does that feeling only happen at night?

Mostly at night. During the day it’s more like I just forget to eat or skip meals without really thinking about it. Then late at night, after midnight, I’ll end up going through takeout or snacks and feel like I’m kind of out of control with it. That’s honestly what scared me.
Do you find that most of your daily eating happens in the evening or at night, after dinner time?

Yeah, a lot of it ends up being late, honestly. Some days I’ll barely eat or just forget meals, and then after dinner time—really after midnight sometimes—I’m suddenly eating a bunch of takeout or snacks. It’s been pretty all over the place, and that’s what scared me.
When you’re eating a lot at night, do you feel like you’re eating a very large amount of food in a short period of time?

Yeah, sometimes it feels like that. Like I’ll forget meals earlier in the day, and then after midnight I’m just tearing through takeout or snacks. It feels like a lot all at once, and that’s what kind of scared me.
Do you ever feel like you can't control how much you're eating during the day, or does that feeling only happen at night?

It’s mostly at night, yeah. During the day I might just forget to eat completely, but then after midnight I’ll be going through takeout or snacks and it feels like I’m not really controlling it. That up-and-down eating is part of what scared me into coming in.
During those late-night eating episodes, do you feel like you have no control over how much you eat or that you can't stop eating once you start?

Yeah, when it happens late at night, it can feel like I’m just going through the food without really stopping to think. Like I’ll have skipped meals earlier, then after midnight I’m tearing through takeout or snacks, and it feels kind of out of control. That’s part of what made me worry.
Do you feel distressed specifically about the fact that these eating episodes happen at night, or is your distress more about the overall pattern of your eating being out of control?

It’s more the overall pattern, I think. The night part is part of it, but what really scared me is how all over the place it’s been—some days I’ll forget to eat meals completely, and then other nights after midnight I’m going through takeout and snacks like I can’t slow down.
